purpose: A public canonical tourism place is saved once and rendered consistently in hanok, map, Odii-linked, and member timeline experiences.

fixtures.name: hanok-save-is-map-save
fixtures.given: A signed-in member saves canonical placeId p-hanok-01 from a hanok detail page.
then: The response has resourceType PLACE, resourceId p-hanok-01, savedByMe true, and savedAt.
The hanok card, map place card, and any Odii-linked place card for p-hanok-01 render savedByMe true after their next server read.
No KTO contentId or provider DTO is stored or returned as the saved resource identity.

fixtures.name: all-public-tourism-place-categories-use-place
fixtures.given: A member saves published canonical places classified as hanok, hanok stay, hanok cafe, hanok experience, traditional market, and tourist attraction.
then: Every supported published category uses the same /saved-resources/places/{placeId} endpoint.
The member timeline emits SAVED_PLACE items with the current place name, category, region, thumbnail when available, and saved timestamp.
Unsupported, unpublished, ambiguous, or deleted source rows return NOT_FOUND and create no saved row.

fixtures.name: guest-place-save-intent
fixtures.given: A guest presses the save control on p-hanok-01.
then: The FE asks for login and keeps only a short-lived placeId plus desired saved state intent.
After a successful Kakao login, the FE sends one PUT only if the place is still public.
Login cancellation or failure creates no saved resource; local intent is not presented as savedByMe true.

fixtures.name: odii-linked-place-is-primary-save
fixtures.given: An Odii story has a reviewed audio_place_odii_links relation to p-attraction-02.
then: The Odii screen renders the linked tourism place card and its savedByMe state.
Saving that card writes PLACE p-attraction-02, not the source Odii or provider identifier.
An ODII_STORY save remains an optional, separate replay action; it does not replace the linked place save.

fixtures.name: timeline-and-unavailable-place
fixtures.given: A member saved p-hanok-01 in September and it is later unpublished or deleted.
then: While public, GET /me/timeline returns a SAVED_PLACE item that can render date, place name, category, region, thumbnail, and a PLACE target.
After it becomes unavailable, saved-resource lists and timeline items do not expose stale title, image, or a substituted place.
The relevant month may increment unavailableCount; deleting the save remains idempotent.
